key_insight: BubbleSH provides a compact, high-fidelity dataset of rising deformable bubbles that couples trajectory and shape evolution for learning chaotic multiphase dynamics.
engineering_relevance: It gives engineers a benchmark for building and testing data-driven bubbly-flow simulators where bubble deformation and interactions matter.
method: High-fidelity DNS of bubble swarms in a periodic domain
Time-resolved storage of trajectories, velocities, and spherical-harmonics shape descriptors
Benchmarking with trajectory and shape prediction metrics for probabilistic emulation
evidence_signal: The abstract reports transient 3D bubble-swarm simulations plus new evaluation metrics for both trajectory and shape prediction, and tests an equivariant probabilistic emulator on the dataset.
watch_item: Because bubble-swarm dynamics are highly sensitive to local perturbations, models may need strong equivariance and uncertainty handling to remain stable and physically consistent.
paper_title: BubbleSH: A Dataset of Rising Bubbles with Deformable Interfaces
